choice.title: wasync
choice.description: The wasync terminal app, command-line tool and local engine. Installs /usr/local/bin/wasync. Always installed.

choice.title: AXI for agents (whatsapp-axi)
choice.description: Optional. Installs /usr/local/bin/whatsapp-axi, the command that AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode use to work with your local wasync archive. What an agent may read or send is decided by the access you grant in wasync. This installer does not change any agent settings.
